title: Pokemon TCG Pocket Expansions V5 Schema

release_date.description: ISO 8601 release date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null for promo sets.

total_cards.description: Total number of cards in the expansion.

cards_url.description: URL to the full (pretty-printed) card JSON for this expansion.

cards_url_min.description: URL to the minified card JSON for this expansion.

cards_core_url.description: URL to the core variant shard for this expansion.

cards_core_url_min.description: URL to the minified core variant shard for this expansion.

cards_core_no_image_url.description: URL to the core no-image variant shard for this expansion.

cards_core_no_image_url_min.description: URL to the minified core no-image variant shard for this expansion.

cards_gameplay_url.description: URL to the gameplay variant shard for this expansion.

cards_gameplay_url_min.description: URL to the minified gameplay variant shard for this expansion.

cards_gameplay_no_image_url.description: URL to the gameplay no-image variant shard for this expansion.

cards_gameplay_no_image_url_min.description: URL to the minified gameplay no-image variant shard for this expansion.

cards_collection_url.description: URL to the collection variant shard for this expansion.

cards_collection_url_min.description: URL to the minified collection variant shard for this expansion.

cards_collection_no_image_url.description: URL to the collection no-image variant shard for this expansion.

cards_collection_no_image_url_min.description: URL to the minified collection no-image variant shard for this expansion.

image.description: URL to the WebP pack image.

image_png.description: URL to the PNG pack image.
